title: PvP Tactics
intro: Fight together, pick targets deliberately, and keep rallies reinforced.

items.title: Swarming
items.body: Swarming means that all armies should mass attack the same designated target together, at the same time. So it becomes 100+ allied armies VS 1 enemy army.

items.title: Refilling
items.body: Refilling someone means that you should reinforce it. If you already reinforced it, it means you should withdraw your almost defeated march and reinforce it again with a new full army. Account for march time before joining again.

sections.title: Stay with your allies
items: Stick together as a tight group with your allies. Which is called a "Murderball". Swarm enemy armies that come near the murderball. Retreat and push together.
Do not target an enemy army alone. Follow the Murderball and always fight together.
When possible, fight inside your tribe territory. Tribe territory gives you huge amounts of buffs, which could change the outcome of the battle drastically.

sections.title: Choose your targets
items: Look for the march already targeted by your allies. You can see this by the direction your allies are facing and how the enemies health will decrease quicker then other surrounding armies.
In general, try to target enemy armies in this order:
Archer armies
Infantry armies
Pikemen armies
Fight strategically eliminate the weakest enemies first and then the strongest last.

sections.title: When a stronger enemy targets you
items: Retreat your army, so the enemy army starts to chase your army, distracting it from the real battlefield.
Quickly reinforce in a tribe tower or base, so the enemy army retreats back home automatically, and so you are no longer being targeted.

sections.title: Keep your hospitals clear
items: Never let your own troops die on a field battle! Heal during a field battle if you need to, to prevent your hospitals from filling up and received deaths.
It is many times cheaper to heal troops, compared to training new troops!

sections.title: Join and refill rallies
items: Only let T7 whales with strong % start rallies. As the rally commanders of the rally leader only matter. All troops inside the rally with fight with their %.
Reinforce the rally with the rally commanders troop type if possible.

Before joining a rally, always check first if you can march there in time. If not, march your army near the starting location or on its path. So you can later join / refill the rally. This is to prevent the whole rally waiting simply on you.
Always try to reinforce a rally whenever possible. It fights much better when it is completely filled.
Dont swarm the rally target, unless command is given. Let the rally do its work.
If you see allied armies swarming a target, while the swarming command is not given, do not follow them to their deaths!

sections.title: Incoming enemy rallies
items: Do not swarm an incomin rally unless command is given. Otherwise you fight 2 million + troops alone. You will lose.
Wait till a counter rally is launched or the command to swarm the rally is given.
If you see allied armies swarming a target, while the swarming command is not given, do not follow them to their deaths!
